## Closing — B3 client side shipped; server-side remainder split to #2559

**Shipped (objectui):**
- Per-option `visibleWhen` + `dependsOn` client feature — gating, live re-filter, cascade-clear (#2284), plus dependent query-backed lookups (#2215), in v12.0.0.
- Build-time guardrail (`lintOptionPredicates`), catalog guardrail test, role-gated demo, **ADR-0058**, and a real-browser cascade e2e — **#2547 (merged)**.

**Remaining (framework + one objectui live e2e) → tracked in #2559:**
- Server-side option-value enforcement in `@objectstack/objectql` (reject a submitted value whose option `visibleWhen` is FALSE; fail-open; mirror the `requiredWhen` path per ADR-0036).
- A showcase cascading fixture (+ role-gated option).
- Live-backend e2e asserting the server rejects an out-of-set value.

Closing this tracker as the client-side scope is complete; the cross-repo server enforcement continues in **#2559**.
